{{Quote|You should know the darkness has been with us for centuries. My father, his father&hellip;|King Ommin, speaking of his dark side heritage|audio=OmminCenturies.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
The '''father''' of [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] native to the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].

==Biography==
He was [[King/Legends|King]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] from an unknown date until his own [[Death/Legends|death]], presumably in the year [[4018 BBY]], at which time his son [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] ascended to the throne in his place.

A thrall of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Ommin's father was trained in the ways of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Ancient]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] by the [[Force ghost/Legends|spectre]] of his ancestor, the deceased [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of the Sith [[Freedon Nadd]]. In the tradition of [[Iziz ruling family|his forefathers]], after completing his own [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprenticeship]] under Nadd, he instructed his son, Ommin, in the ways of the dark side.
